'''David Jones'''<ref name="dt-19852">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19852 Huntdown My Way(this is the real one)], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 27 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19852/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19852/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016221921/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19852/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''DavCJ''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in November 2001.
